title: ObjectJointHelicalZ: the helical (screw) joint about z
author: Claude-JG
description: The joint of docs/dev/design/helicalJoint.md (#3415): the frame of marker 1 on a screw motion about z of marker 0 with the pitch h per radian; 5 equations, the radial translations, the two tilts and the coupling d_z - h phi with phi the angle on the branch nearest d_z/h (no state, h = 0 the revolute joint), each lockable by constrainedAxes; analytic rows on the rigid connector interface, the velocity level for index 2; output variables with the continuous angle and the axial force; the drawing of the axis and the thread; a MiniExample (revision2026c step RG9.14.2).
releaseNotes: ObjectJointHelicalZ, a helical (screw) joint about the z-axis of marker 0 with the pitch per radian: the turns are counted by the axial position, no extra state; each of the 5 constraints can be switched off (cylindrical, planar and spherical variants; pitch 0 is the revolute joint); analytic Jacobian, index 2 support, the continuous angle and the axial force as outputs.
